fields.label: The chain, measured end to end
value: ProduceTerrainBatch's admission test (ContactProducer.cpp:77-81) was a PLANE-distance test; a plane is unbounded, so it was never a locality test.
The 256-entry batch saturated on 3565 of 3565 solver calls and the loop stopped scanning, so the triangles under wheels 0 and 1 never reached the classifier 0x0046cc40.
Their contact key +0x1ec therefore stayed at the init loop's -1 (fv == 10.0 exactly on all 99 rows).
0x0046f6c0's state machine demoted them at 0x0046f91a/0x0046f91f — arm A-demote-key, 99 of 356 wheel-rows.
bVar16 became 2, the byte-faithful 0 < count <= 2.0 gate at 0x004701e8 opened, and the airborne drift fired 47 times in 29 frames = 84.33% of T_post.

fields.label: The ORIGINAL has no cap
fields.value: LAB_00468b80 increments DAT_0088e60c unconditionally at 0x00468d6c..0x00468d73, with no bound test anywhere in 0x00468b80..0x00468d7c. Its locality comes entirely from the BSP walk FUN_00538c80 that ProduceTerrainBatch stands in for.

fields.label: The fix
fields.value: The admission test is now SPATIAL (the triangle's AABB grown by the same radius must contain the same query centre) and is the default. No new numeric constant, no knob on the shipping path, no clamp, no fitted value. MASHED_D2_BATCHMODE=plane is the diagnostic pre-fix arm and reproduces attempt 19 bit-for-bit.
